استغربا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْرَبَا (istaḡrabā) /is.taɣ.ra.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# اُسْتُغْرِبَا (ustuḡribā) /us.tuɣ.ri.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# اِسْتَغْرِبَا (istaḡribā) /is.taɣ.ri.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
